title: Mince Pies
hookLine: British-inspired mince pies with 6 measured ingredients — zero sign-up, instant Cook Mode.

steps.title: Prep & Mix: Mince Pies
steps.instructionTemplate: To make the pastry, rub 225g cold, diced butter into 350g plain flour, then mix in 100g golden caster sugar and a pinch of salt. Combine the pastry into a ball – don’t add liquid – and knead it briefly. The dough will be fairly firm, like shortbread dough. You can use the dough immediately, or chill for later. Incorporate {m52991_1}, {m52991_2}, {m52991_3}, and {m52991_4} smoothly until evenly distributed.
steps.creatorSecret: Prep and measure butter first—mise en place makes this dessert twice as fast.

steps.title: Build Flavor: Mince Pies
steps.instructionTemplate: Preheat the oven to 200C/gas 6/fan 180C. Line 18 holes of two 12-hole patty tins, by pressing small walnut-sized balls of pastry into each hole. Spoon 280g mincemeat into the pies. Incorporate {m52991_5} and {m52991_6} smoothly until evenly distributed.

steps.title: Shape & Layer: Mince Pies
steps.instructionTemplate: Take slightly smaller balls of pastry than before and pat them out between your hands to make round lids, big enough to cover the pies. Top the pies with their lids, pressing the edges gently together to seal – you don’t need to seal them with milk or egg as they will stick on their own. (The pies may now be frozen for up to 1 month).

steps.title: Bake / Chill: Mince Pies
steps.instructionTemplate: Beat 1 small egg and brush the tops of the pies. Bake for 20 mins until golden. Leave to cool in the tin for 5 mins, then remove to a wire rack. To serve, lightly dust with icing sugar.
steps.criticalTip: Let set for 5–10 minutes before slicing or plating so the textures hold crisp and photogenic!
steps.creatorSecret: Chill the filled crust 10 minutes before baking—cold butter hits the hot oven and puffs into extra-flaky layers.

ugcQuotes.quote: Followed the scaled metric steps—came out flawless in 45 mins!
